record.paper_title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
record.original_question: For the memory-smearing model with cognitive-map diffusion coefficient ε_i, in what sense do solutions converge to those of the nondiffusive conflict-memory model as ε_i tends to 0 from above?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 16. In what sense do solutions of the problem (2.15) converge to solutions of problem (2.13) in the limit as εi → 0+?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider two models for the density u_i(x,t) ≥ 0 of species i on a smooth bounded domain Ω ⊂ ℝ^n (i = 1, ..., N), coupled with cognitive (conflict-memory) maps k_i(x,t) ≥ 0.

(A) Memory-smearing model (with diffusion of the cognitive map). For ε_i > 0, fix initial data (u_i(·,0), k_i(·,0)) and no-flux boundary conditions, and solve
   ∂_t u_i = ∇·(D_i ∇u_i − u_i χ_i ∇(K_i * k_i)) + f_i(u_1, ..., u_N),
   ∂_t k_i = ε_i Δ k_i + g_i(u_1, ..., u_N) − μ_i k_i,
on Ω × (0, ∞), with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions for u_i and k_i. Here D_i, χ_i, μ_i > 0 are constants, K_i is a smooth spatial averaging kernel, and f_i, g_i are smooth functions modeling population kinetics and conflict-driven memory acquisition.

(B) Nondiffusive conflict-memory model. The same system with ε_i = 0, so that k_i satisfies the pointwise ODE ∂_t k_i = g_i(u_1, ..., u_N) − μ_i k_i, with the same initial data, and u_i satisfies the same PDE as in (A).

Question. Let (u_i^{ε}, k_i^{ε}) denote a solution of (A) and (u_i^{0}, k_i^{0}) a solution of (B), corresponding to identical initial data. In what precise functional sense (e.g., in which Banach/Sobolev norms, on which time intervals, and under what regularity assumptions on the initial data and kernels) does (u_i^{ε}, k_i^{ε}) converge to (u_i^{0}, k_i^{0}) as ε_i → 0^+? Identify a topology and convergence rate, together with hypotheses on the initial data and parameters, for which this singular-limit convergence holds.
artifact.category_tag: singular limits in nonlocal reaction-diffusion-advection systems
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in a 2022/2023 survey on PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement. Web search did not surface any published rigorous singular-limit (ε → 0⁺) convergence result connecting the memory-smearing model to the nondiffusive conflict-memory model; related research has developed well-posedness theory for related cognitive-map PDE-ODE systems but does not seem to resolve this particular zero-smearing limit.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems on cognitive-map PDE models, including the ε_i → 0+ limit linking the memory-smearing and conflict-memory models.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly posed as open in the survey.

status_evidence.title: Biological aggregations from spatial memory and nonlocal advection
status_evidence.snippet: Studies PDE-ODE systems for spatial memory and nonlocal advection without addressing the zero-diffusion limit of the cognitive map.
status_evidence.claim: Related follow-up work does not establish the singular-limit convergence in question.
